text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with Grass 
Wonder. She seemed to have a place in 
mind, so we headed to an inn.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Long time no see, everyone~.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
It's the Umamusume big sis! Long time no 
see~!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Onee-chan! What do you wanna play 
today~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment they see Grass Wonder's face, 
the children's eyes light up as they 
gather around her.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they're the kids from this inn. They 
know all kinds of traditional Japanese 
games, you see.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We've been good friends ever since we 
played beanbags together before~.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
We played together so much, didn't we! 
Like ohajiki, cat's cradle, karuta—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Having such a rare experience 
brings me great joy as well~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So, what shall we do today?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... But I feel like I've already played 
most games I know with my big sister.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
I know! Sis, you teach me something today! 
Like the games you used to play when you 
were little!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Me?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Um, well... I never got to play games like 
everyone else when I was little. So what 
should I—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
From... America? Still, whether these kids 
will like it or not—

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Big Sis, you came 
from America, right? That's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! Teach me some American games~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, understooood~ Well then, this 'Simon 
Says' thing—

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Simon!? Sounds like a foreigner's name...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes. After all, I am an 
American-born Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Both Japan and America. They are both 
precious places where my roots lie~.
choice_data_list:
Tell me more stories about America again, 
will ya?

Tell me more stories about America again, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Both Japan and America. They are both 
precious places where my roots lie~.
choice_data_list:
Tell me more stories about America again, 
will ya?

Tell me more stories about America again, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. 'Simon Says' is a game where you 
follow the leader's commands, but—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Experience is the best teacher." I'll act 
as the parent, so why don't we try it out 
first~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Um... let's see. Right hand up—

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: I don't understand English at all~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ah... Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
When I thought about getting people to 
know about my hometown, I just couldn't 
help getting excited~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The four of us played until sundown. It 
was a day that let me understand Grass 
Wonder's feelings toward America.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, by all means. I have so much to tell 
you~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My father is a typically broad-minded and 
boisterous American, but he absolutely 
loves Japan...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"On the other hand, my mother is the 
epitome of the traditional Japanese woman, 
the very ideal I strive to be—"
choice_data_list:
You've inherited from both of them, 
haven't you?

You've inherited from both of them, 
haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ............ Fufu, that's true~.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Big sis! Come play with me already~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'm sorry. Let's play right away.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. We can continue our chat 
leisurely on the way home, right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home after playing until 
sundown, Grass Wonder happily shared her 
memories of living in America.
